## Financial Statement Analyzer

Receives financial statement data, calculates profitability, liquidity, leverage, and efficiency ratios, uses OpenAI to interpret results, and sends analysis to Sheets and email.

**Setup:**
1. Add OpenAI, Google Sheets, Gmail credentials
2. POST with financial data: `{"company": "...", "revenue": 1000000, "netIncome": 150000, ...}`
3. All numeric fields optional — will calculate available ratios
